title: From coding to building a company: My journey in starting a successful product company

blocks.html:
The journey from a computer science student unsure of the career path to becoming an entrepreneur in the software industry. I will take you through the challenges I faced, the lessons learned, and the pivotal moments that shaped my path.

I will discuss how I made the decision to pursue entrepreneurship, the valuable experiences gained from my first failed product, and the transformative decision to create Base, a sales management software for small businesses. Through my story, I want to emphasize the importance of listening to customer feedback, building a stellar team, and the role of growth in making key business decisions.
